name: DEATH GUARD: FOETID BLOAT-DRONE
description: Foetid Bloat-drones thrum through the air on rasping turbines, providing the Death Guard with mobile support. Their spiteful animating entities can be equipped with various weaponry, including savage fleshmowers, diseased plaguespitters, and long-ranged, drum-fed heavy blight launchers.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds one Foetid Bloat-drone, a hovering Daemon Engine for your Death Guard armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. These intimidating amalgamations of machine and rotting meat can be constructed with your choice of three different carapaces and two different plague probes, making them easy to customise. They can be armed with a pair of plague spitters to take out hordes of enemy troops, a heavy blight launcher to threaten tanks, or a hideously effective fleshmower to cut down your foes in close combat. No matter how they're armed, Foetid Bloat-drones are ideal swift harassment units to outflank your enemy.</br></br>This kit comprises 44 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 60mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
